name: Same Behavior, Different Reasons
save_share_trigger: SEND: 'Send this to the friend who always says yes.' Recognition of someone else drives DM sends (IG's strongest reach signal). Secondary: comment 1/2/3.

variables.behavior_bank: BEHAVIOR_BANK (7 behaviors x 3 reasons, EN + AR)

ar_notes: Use the approved AR difference block for 'say no'. Reasons in nominal or third-person form (أحدهم / آخر / ثالث) so no gendered 'you'. Right-aligned; numerals ٠١ ٠٢ ٠٣.
compliance: Reasons are hedged ('may', 'one person'), never diagnoses of the viewer.
No clinical words (anxiety, trauma, codependency, disorder).

slides_or_beats.instruction: Open loop on the shared behavior. Default headline: 'Same behavior. Different reasons.' Sub-line names it: 'Three people struggle to say no.'
slides_or_beats.visual: Hero object: three tall crystal points side by side, one lit.

slides_or_beats.instruction: The behavior in one everyday second-person moment ('Someone asks for a favor. You say yes before they finish the sentence.'). Must work as a standalone hook: IG re-serves slide 2 to people who skipped slide 1.
Person one: the first reason, one sentence, plus what it may be protecting (<=10 words). Hedge with 'may'.
Person two: a different reason. Same sentence shape as slide 3 so the contrast is visible.
Person three: the third reason.
All three side by side. Top band repeats the behavior; then 'The behavior looks the same. The pattern behind it may be completely different.' Each card <=64 chars.
Question to the reader: 'Which one sounds closest: 1, 2 or 3?' plus one line on why the same advice ('just set boundaries') may fit one person and backfire for another.
Tier copy + 'Your context changes the interpretation.' Disclaimer footer.

tiktok_photo_adaptation: Re-render 1080x1920 from the same fields. Keep all 8 slides. Title (<=90 chars) = slide-1 headline + behavior. Put the search keyword (e.g. 'people pleasing', 'how to say no') on slide 1 or 2: TikTok reads on-image text.

'This is 1 of the 12 questions in the MCC questionnaire. No right answers. Notice which line you pause on.'
Option 1 verbatim (founder wording) + one hedged line 'For some people, this is about...'.
Option 2 + hedged line.
Option 3 + hedged line.
Option 4 + hedged line.
The steadiest option from the same question ('I can receive it, say thank you, and let it be good.') + 'If this is you, notice what made it possible.' Keeps the post non-pathologizing.
'Comment your number.' + 'One answer is one piece. A reading looks at all twelve together.' + tier copy.

tiktok_photo_adaptation: Re-render 1080x1920. Keep 8 slides. Title = the question. Ask for the number in the description too ('Comment 1-5').
